verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਨਾਮਦੇ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit_en: raag soraTh baanee bhagat naamadhe jee kee ghar doojaa

en.bdb: Raag Sorat'h, The Word Of Devotee Naam Dayv Jee, Second House:
en.ms: Sorath Measure. Hymns of Sire Saint Namdev ji.

en.bdb: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
en.ms: There is but One God. By True Guru's grace, He is obtained.

en.bdb: When I see Him, I sing His Praises.
en.ms: When I see my Lord, then sing I His praise.

en.bdb: Then I, his humble servant, become patient. ||1||
en.ms: It is then, that I, His slave, obtain forbearance.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਦਿ ਸਮਾਇਲੋ ਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਲੇ ਦੇਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit_en: naadh samailo re satigur bheTile dhevaa ||1|| rahaau ||

en.bdb: Meeting the Divine True Guru, I merge into the sound current of the Naad. ||1||Pause||
en.ms: Meeting with the Bright True Guru. I have merged in the world-incarnate Lord. Pause.

en.bdb: Where the dazzling white light is seen,
en.ms: Where the dazzling light is seen,

en.bdb: there the unstruck sound current of the Shabad resounds.
One's light merges in the Light;
en.ms: The Light of the Luminous Lord is pervading there.

en.bdb: by Guru's Grace, I know this. ||2||
en.ms: By Guru's grace I have known it.

en.bdb: The jewels are in the treasure chamber of the heart-lotus.
en.ms: In the heat-lotus chamber are the jewels.

en.bdb: They sparkle and glitter like lightning.
The Lord is near at hand, not far away.
en.ms: The Lord is near, not distant.

en.bdb: He is totally permeating and pervading in my soul. ||3||
Where the light of the undying sun shines,
en.ms: Where there is the light of the undying sun,

en.bdb: the light of burning lamps seems insignificant.
en.ms: there, the burning lamps of the sum and the moon appear insignificant.

en.bdb: By Guru's Grace, I know this.
en.ms: By Guru's grace, I have known this.

en.bdb: Servant Naam Dayv is absorbed in the Celestial Lord. ||4||1||
en.ms: Slave Nama is absorbed in his Lord.
